children: The CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) may rise to $12.58-1/4 per bushel, as it has stabilized around a support at $12.49.
Following the stabilization, the market broke the resistance at $12.52-1/2. The bullish divergence on the hourly RSI suggests a further bounce.

The next resistance will be at $12.58-1/4, a break above which may lead to a gain to $12.63-1/2. On the daily chart, a retracement analysis on the uptrend from $11.65 reveals a support at $12.50-1/4, which works together with the one at $12.49 (hourly chart) to stop the fall.
The bounce on the hourly chart is classified as a pullback toward $12.70-1/4. A channel technique indicates a resumption of the fall toward $12.30, upon the completion of the pullback.
